blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — “Ya, papintal ka, ya?” This is a common phrase you will hear when you visit Carreta Cemetery this weekend in time for Kalag-Kalag 2026. Children carrying small paint cans will approach visitors and ask if they want their loved one’s resting place painted for All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. For P50, they will paint it white to make it look like new.
